parameters.query: SELECT e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.date_hired, eu.email AS employee_email, eu.id AS employee_user_id, mu.email AS manager_email, mu.id AS manager_user_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(current_date, e.date_hired::date))::int AS years_of_service FROM public.employees e JOIN public.users eu ON eu.id = e.user_id LEFT JOIN public.users mu ON mu.id = e.immediate_head WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL AND eu.deleted_at IS NULL AND eu.status = 'active' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.date_hired::date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM e.date_hired::date) = EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY years_of_service DESC, e.last_name, e.first_name;
